_comment: WORLDWIDE (multi-jurisdiction) SEED democratic-participation target registry per ADR-2605312400 §2. Originally JP-only (R0); expanded 2026-06-02 to worldwide coverage across blocs — US (federal + CA/NY/TX), EU (EU-level + DE/FR), UK-CW (GB/CA/AU/IN/SG), and INTL-ROW (BR/MX/KR + UN/EU supranational). Each entry is the coded organ / channel / 根拠法令 / 様式 / 期限 / 紹介議員-flag so moushibumi can route + (eventually) file procedurally. ALL entries ship verificationStatus=unverified-seed: per G14, NO live submission may occur against an unverified entry — these MUST be human/Council-verified (and re-checked within the freshness window) before moushibumi_submit will transmit, and 代行 (R3) additionally requires council-verified + 行政書士法/UPL clearance + Council Lv7+ (G15). Specific portals / windows / 根拠法令 below are best-effort public references and are EXPECTED to drift; non-JP entries verified as of 2026-06-02. CRITICAL (G3): election entries are INFO-ONLY — neutral reference to official sources; no campaigning / endorsement / GOTV.

targets.title: 国会 請願 (衆議院 / 参議院)
targets.organ: 衆議院 / 参議院 (請願は会派の紹介議員を経て提出)
targets.submissionForm: 請願書 (件名・要旨・請願者の住所氏名・紹介議員署名)
targets.deadline: 会期中 (会期末の一定期日前まで; 院により異なる — 要確認)
targets.legalBasis: 日本国憲法 §16; 請願法; 国会法 §79-§82
targets.notes: 国会への請願は紹介議員が必須 (国会法 §79)。moushibumi は請願書の起草補助 + 様式確認に限定; 紹介議員の斡旋・働きかけは行わない (G9 non-partisan)。会期・締切は院ごとに要確認。

targets.legalBasis: 地方自治法 §124 (請願); 陳情は法定外だが多くの議会が受理
targets.notes: 請願 (地方自治法 §124) は紹介議員必須、陳情は不要 (法定外・任意受理)。具体的な 議会事務局 窓口/締切は per-自治体 resolve。TEMPLATE entry。

targets.title: Federal rulemaking public comment via Regulations.gov (連邦規則制定パブリックコメント)

targets.deadline: Per-rule comment period (commonly 30-60 days); confirm open/close date on the specific docket
targets.legalBasis: Administrative Procedure Act, 5 U.S.C. § 553 (notice-and-comment / informal rulemaking): agency publishes a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking in the Federal Register and gives interested persons an opportunity to submit written data, views, or arguments.
targets.notes: Any person (citizen or not) may comment; comments are public record and may include name/affiliation. DRIFT WARNING: comment periods are time-bound and vary per rule — confirm the open/close date on the specific docket before relying. UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for routing/wayfinding only; not for live use. BOUNDARY: INFO + procedure only; submitting a comment is the member's own act. UPL caveat: moushibumi does not draft legal arguments, assess a rule's legality, or represent the member — direct legal-advice needs to a licensed attorney. Political-neutrality (公選法-equivalent): INFO + procedure ONLY. NO campaigning / endorsement / candidate ranking / GOTV targeting. Election entries are neutral reference to OFFICIAL sources only.

targets.deadline: 500-signature threshold to be presented; government must respond within 45 days (Standing-Order-based — re-confirm)
targets.legalBasis: Standing Orders of the House of Commons of Canada, S.O. 36 and the e-petitions provisions (S.O. 36(5) onward), adopted 2015; House of Commons Procedure and Practice, 3rd ed. (2017), ch. 22 (Public Petitions).

targets.title: India pre-legislative public consultation on draft bills (MyGov / ministry consultation portals)
targets.organ: Government of India ministries (sponsoring department of each draft bill); MyGov (citizen-engagement platform under MeitY) and individual ministry websites host comment windows
targets.submissionForm: Comment on draft bills via https://www.mygov.in/ and the relevant ministry's website / e-Gazette draft-rule notices (ad hoc per bill)
targets.deadline: Policy minimum of 30 days for comments — frequently not met in practice; locate the specific draft-bill notice
targets.legalBasis: Pre-Legislative Consultation Policy (PLCP), 2014 — Government of India directive requiring draft bills to be placed in the public domain for a minimum of 30 days for comments, with a note on justification, financial implications and impact. (Policy/executive directive, not an enacted statute.)
targets.notes: UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for routing/wayfinding only — never live use. IMPORTANT DRIFT/ENFORCEMENT CAVEAT: the PLCP is an executive policy, NOT a statute, and is inconsistently applied — many bills are introduced without any public consultation, and the 30-day window is often not met. There is no single permanent national consultation portal; comment windows appear ad hoc on MyGov and individual ministry sites, so the channel URL is indicative, not a guaranteed live endpoint — always locate the specific draft-bill notice. Non-governmental trackers (e.g. PRS Legislative Research at prsindia.org, Civis) help find open consultations but are NOT official channels. NOT legal advice (UPL boundary). Political-neutrality (公選法-equivalent): INFO + procedure ONLY. NO campaigning / endorsement / candidate ranking / GOTV targeting. Election entries are neutral reference to OFFICIAL sources only.

targets.title: Mexico — Federal Popular Consultation, citizen-initiated (Consulta Popular ciudadana, art. 35 fr. VIII)
targets.organ: Congreso de la Unión (convenes); Instituto Nacional Electoral (INE) (organizes/verifies signatures); Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación (constitutionality review)
targets.submissionForm: Citizen request requires signatures of ≥2% of the nominal electoral roll (lista nominal); INE verifies signatures via https://portal.ine.mx/consultapopular/
targets.deadline: Event-based: consulta held the first Sunday of August of the relevant year (per the Constitution); results bind federal Executive/Legislative when participation ≥40% of the lista nominal
targets.legalBasis: Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos art. 35, fracción VIII (citizen right to request a popular consultation; ≥2% of the lista nominal de electores); Ley Federal de Consulta Popular (LFCPo), last reform pub. 19-05-2021.
targets.notes: Real constitutional mechanism; first federal consulta popular held 2021-08-01. The citizen-initiation route (2% of the lista nominal, with INE verifying signatures) is a genuine democratic-participation channel, distinct from President/Congress-initiated consultations. DRIFT WARNING: no standing federal citizen-participation law beyond the LFCPo; the consulta is event-based (first Sunday of August), not an always-open portal — verify whether an active signature-collection window exists. targets.deadline: Rolling per-call deadlines — check the listing for an active call and its deadline
targets.legalBasis: UN Human Rights Council mandate establishing Special Procedures — HRC Resolution 5/1 (Institution-building package, 18 June 2007) and the Code of Conduct (Resolution 5/2); General Assembly Resolution 60/251 (creating the Human Rights Council).
